title: Engineering Manager, MAAS
description:
Empresa está contratando Engineering Manager, MAAS em são paulo. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Engineering Manager as we expand the MAAS team.  Our mission with MAAS ("Metal as a Service") is to provide the best solution for building and running private bare-metal infrastructure, putting a cloud-style on-demand API in front of physical server provisioning, network configuration, and storage. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality software development and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux on physical servers, Linux storage and data center networking capabilities. The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service (MAAS) hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get Ubuntu on bare metal servers. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go. Its components span the entire software stack: from low-level hardware detection and provisioning, to the upper level management web interface, API, and CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system. Canonical is seeking passionate technical leaders who are eager to drive innovation in one of Canonical's flagship data center products. You will play a key role in reshaping the future of data center technology through open source management platforms. MAAS aims to revolutionize data center management at scale starting from day zero deployment to long term data center expansion and maintenance. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence team and company culture, facilitate technical delivery, and guide strategy and execution. In addition to these responsibilities, you will be expected to collaborate across engineering. The MAAS team regularly interfaces with teams responsible for cloud-init, LXD, and our public cloud offerings. The successful candidate will have technical leadership attributes and can demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems. Location This is a work-from-anywhere position available in EMEA or the Americas. The role entails Leading a distributed team of engineers in your time zone (we organise engineering teams by Americas, EMEA etc) Talent development through coaching, mentoring, feedback and career planning Setting and managing expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders Being an advocate of, and advancing, modern software development practices Participating in the engineering process through code and architectural review Engaging with broader teams at Canonical, the open source community and partners Travelling to internal and external global events for 4 to 6 weeks per year  What we are looking for in you Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and a background in Computer Science Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university Proven experience delivering software using Python, Golang, or similar languages Experience with Linux system administration (Debian or Ubuntu preferred) Familiarity with modern Linux cloud computing technologies, including networking, storage, containers and K8S Technical aptitude for understanding complex distributed systems Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills Experience with agile software development methodologies Ability to mentor, develop, and support team members Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long  Nice-to-have skills Typescript using modern web frameworks such as React, Angular, Svelte or Vue Data Center infrastructure management and design  What we offer colleagues Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004! Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year Annual compensation review Recognition rewards Annual holiday leave Maternity and paternity leave Employee Assistance Programme Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events  About Canonical Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Digital Content Analyst
description:

Job Description  This role blends analytical skills with a strong understanding of digital content and marketing to create, plan, implement, and optimize content strategies that drive brand positioning and enrollment growth. Reporting directly to the Content Marketing Manager, this role is integral to supporting the Marketing team at the São Paulo campus, ensuring that all content aligns with Avenues’ mission and branding philosophies, with strong ownership over Avenues São Paulo’s digital content presence and a high standard of editorial judgment and strategic thinking.  Responsibilities   Responsible for developing and managing implementation schedules and strategic actions to ensure timely and effective content delivery across channels (including social media, email campaigns, website, and blog articles) in alignment with overall marketing objectives.  Monitors, collects, and analyzes performance data (traffic, engagement, conversions, etc.) across channels to produce comprehensive reports with actionable insights and recommendations for content optimization and campaign improvements.  Creates, publishes, and manages written and visual content tailored to different audiences, in the form of website updates, blog articles, email marketing, social media posts/messages, campaigns etc, ensuring alignment with Avenues’ brand, tone, and marketing objectives.  Owns the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of digital content across platforms, ensuring high editorial standards and strategic alignment with enrollment and brand objectives.  Conducts competitive research and monitors public sentiment and digital trends to identify opportunities for differentiation, growth, and audience engagement.  Manages and maintains a content calendar to ensure timely, strategic, and consistent content delivery aligned with marketing initiatives and key admissions dates and events.  Supports multimedia content production, including video and photo shooting and editing, to deliver high‑quality, impactful digital assets.  Monitors and manages the online community by responding to comments, messages, and inquiries, fostering positive interactions and building an engaged digital audience.  Collaborates with external PR and marketing agencies to ensure alignment of our messaging, strategy, and goals.  Engages with faculty and academic teams to understand classroom experiences and learning practices, translating them into accurate, compelling, and authentic content narratives.  Collaborates closely with Admissions and Marketing to interpret content performance in relation to enrollment goals, supporting data‑informed decisions across the admissions funnel.  Continuously monitors trends in content marketing, social media, and digital analytics, translating insights and performance data into strategic evolution of content formats, channels, and narratives.    Qualifications   Fluent in both Portuguese and English.  Strong editorial judgment and the ability to write, edit, and adapt high‑quality content fluently in both English and Portuguese for different audiences and channels.  Solid experience in a Marketing and Social Media role.  Proficiency in Adobe Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and Premiere.  A degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field is preferred.  Strong Verbal and Written Communication Skills.  Experience using CRM and analytics tools (such as HubSpot and Salesforce) to inform content strategy and performance optimization.  Experience with Google Ads/Analytics, Meta, CRM, and SEO.  Extreme attention to detail and organization with proven project management skills, from ideation to completion in a fast‑growing, quick‑moving environment, and the ability to prioritize.  A desire to work as part of a highly collaborative and can‑do team, a hands‑on, entrepreneurial approach, and eager to roll up your sleeves and tackle challenges.  A results‑oriented, collaborative approach to project management.  Experience in education is desirable but not required. A strong interest in school routines and innovative educational methodologies is essential.    Additional Information  Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.  Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

description:

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
Nova oportunidade para Enterprise Account Executive em região geográfica intermediária de são paulo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Sphere Labs  The infrastructure moving the world's money today was built for another era: slow rails, walls between markets, and compliance layered in over time creating friction. Sphere Labs is building what comes next: modern, compliance-native infrastructure for cross-border payments and settlement, designed from the ground up to work for the businesses and regulated institutions it actually runs through. We work in active partnership with banks, licensed entities, and the regulators and jurisdictions shaping how global money moves, because the infrastructure that earns institutional trust has to be built alongside it. Backed by Coinbase, Kraken, The Chernin Group, Jump Trading, Hudson River Trading, and some of the world's largest sovereign affiliates, we're a fully remote, global team building at the moment stablecoins are crossing into mainstream finance and regulated institutions are ready for modern rails. We hire self-starters: strong communicators and systematic thinkers who can look at a blank page and build something real. If you want a meaningful role in how global money movement evolves, and the upside that comes with getting in early, we'd like to meet you.  The Role  We're hiring an Enterprise Account Executive  to lead our go-to-market efforts in Brazil. This is a high-impact, senior individual contributor role for a proven enterprise seller who understands the Brazilian payments ecosystem inside and out—and sees where stablecoins fit into its future. You'll own the full sales cycle from identifying opportunities to closing multi-year enterprise deals. Your targets are the fintechs, banks, and payment service providers (PSPs) that are shaping Brazil's financial infrastructure. You'll sell to senior finance and payments leaders, helping them understand how stablecoin rails can reduce costs, accelerate settlement, and unlock new revenue streams. This is a building role. You'll be instrumental in defining our Brazil GTM strategy, informing product development for the region, and establishing Sphere as the trusted infrastructure partner for stablecoin payments in Latin America's largest economy.  What You’ll Do   Own the Full Sales Cycle  Identify, prospect, and close enterprise deals with fintechs, banks, PSPs, and large corporates in Brazil. Manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales processes with procurement, legal, compliance, treasury, and C‑suite buyers. Run discovery, demos, commercial negotiations, pilot programs, and implementation handoffs. Consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.    Build & Manage Pipeline  Leverage your existing network in Brazil's payments ecosystem to generate qualified opportunities. Develop territory and account plans that prioritize high-value, strategic accounts. Maintain disciplined pipeline hygiene and deliver accurate forecasts. Identify and manage local referral partners in the FX industry. Partner with Marketing on targeted campaigns, events, and content for the Brazilian market.    Sell Value at the Executive Level  Position stablecoin infrastructure as a strategic advantage—articulating FX savings, settlement speed, treasury optimization, and new product opportunities. Build business cases and ROI models tailored to each prospect's operations. Develop trusted relationships with CFOs, Heads of Treasury, Heads of Payments, and Chief Product Officers. Navigate regulatory and compliance conversations with confidence.    Be the Voice of Brazil  Represent Sphere at industry events, conferences, and in media engagements across Brazil. Provide market intelligence on competitive dynamics, regulatory developments (BCB, CVM), and customer needs. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Compliance to ensure our platform meets the specific requirements of Brazilian customers. Contribute to building a world-class sales playbook for the region.      What We’re Looking For   Must Have 8+ years of B2B enterprise sales experience  with a consistent track record of exceeding quota selling to fintechs, banks, or PSPs.  Deep payments and FX experience  — you understand cross-border flows, treasury operations, correspondent banking pain points, and how money moves in and out of Brazil.  Crypto/stablecoin experience  — you've sold blockchain infrastructure, digital assets, or crypto-enabled payments products (or you've been a buyer of these solutions).  Existing relationships in Brazil's payments ecosystem  — you have a book of business and a network of senior contacts at target accounts that you can activate from Day 1.  Full‑cycle enterprise selling skills  — you're equally comfortable sourcing your own pipeline, running a technical demo, negotiating an MSA, and quarterbacking a pilot.  Native Portuguese fluency  and professional English proficiency.  Based in Brazil , ideally São Paulo, with willingness to travel internationally.    Nice to Have   Experience selling to or working at Tier 1 Brazilian banks (Itaú, Bradesco, Santander, BTG) or leading fintechs (Nubank, PicPay, Mercado Pago, Stone, PagSeguro).  Understanding of Brazilian regulatory landscape — BCB instant payments (Pix), CVM regulations, crypto licensing developments.  Background in treasury, FX trading, or payments operations.  Experience at a high-growth startup scaling in Brazil.  Spanish proficiency for broader LATAM opportunities.    The Profile  You thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You're not waiting for inbound leads—you're building your own pipeline from relationships you've cultivated over years in the market. You can credibly speak to a Head of Treasury about FX exposure and settlement risk, then pivot to explaining stablecoin rails to a Chief Product Officer exploring embedded finance. You're entrepreneurial but disciplined. You bring structure to chaos—territory plans, account maps, forecasting rigor—while staying flexible enough to adapt as we learn what works in the market. You believe stablecoins are the future of payments infrastructure, and you want to be at the forefront of that shift in Latin America's most important market.  We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.   #J-18808-Ljbffr

Our model focuses on productizing growth consulting  by standardizing recurring growth challenges into structured, outcome-oriented service offeringsdelivered by curated experts.  Role Overview  The Manager – Services Development  will play acritical role in building and scaling the “services layer” of Wadhwani Accelerate’s Assisted Growth Programs.  The role sits at the intersection of product design, expert network development, and service delivery enablement . The individualwill help convert growth challenges faced by SMEs into clearly defined, repeatable service offerings and build a high-quality panel of domain expertswho can deliver these services across regions.  This is a builder role suited for someone who enjoys creating structure out of complexity , working closely with experts, and scaling professional services in a semi-productized model.  Key Responsibilities  1. Services & Product Development   Workwith the Program Head – Accelerate to translate growth archetypes  (e.g., export expansion, domestic scaling, channel growth, customer segmentation) into structured service offerings.  Helpdefine service “modules” across key execution hurdles such as:   Working capital & finance  Sales process & capability  Market entry & channel strategy  Product readiness & positioning  Regulatory & compliance    Support the creation of a service matrix  (growth archetype × execution hurdle) and clearly articulate scope, outcomes, effort, and delivery format for each service.  Assist in defining differentiated service bundles for Accelerate Select, Accelerate Core  cohorts based on advisory hours, delivery format, and expert seniority.    2. Expert Network Building & Management   Identify, onboard, and manage a curated panel of regional and national experts  across domains such as exports, sales growth, compliance, finance, and product strategy.  Build strong working relationships with experts across Gujarat, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Uttar Pradesh.  Define engagement models for experts (retainer, per-assignment, cohort-based delivery, workshops, 1:1 advisory).  Ensure experts are aligned to Wadhwani Accelerate’s service standards, outcomes, and delivery formats.    3. Service Enablement & Quality Assurance   Work with program and operations teams to ensure smooth deployment of services to ventures.  Help standardize service delivery through playbooks, templates, diagnostic frameworks, and checklists.  Monitor service quality, expert effectiveness, and venture feedback to continuously improve offerings.  Support pilots of new services and refine them before scaling.    4. Cross-Functional Collaboration   Collaborate closely with Program, Partnerships, Impact, and Operations teams to align services with cohort needs and outcomes.  Provide inputs into pricing logic, effort estimation, and scalability considerations for services.  Support internal documentation and knowledge management for service offerings.    Candidate Profile  Education & Experience   MBA from a reputed institute.  5–7 years of work experience in consulting, SME advisory, professional services, program management, or ecosystem-focused roles.    Skills & Capabilities   Strong ability to structure ambiguous problems  into clear service offerings.  Experience working with or managing external experts, consultants, or partners .  Understanding of SME growth challenges in areas such as sales, exports, finance, or compliance.  Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.  High execution orientation with attention to detail and follow-through.    Mindset Fit   Comfortable operating in a build-from-scratch, evolving environment .  Interested in scaling impact through systems and platforms, not just bespoke consulting.  Entrepreneurial, collaborative, and outcomes-driven.    Why This Role is Unique   Opportunity to build a first-of-its-kind productized SME growth services model  in India.  Exposure to diverse sectors, geographies, and growth challenges.  Direct influence on how thousands of SMEs access high-quality growth support at scale.  High ownership role with strong learning and leadership visibility.     #J-18808-Ljbffr
